title: dipterocarpus retusus var. macrocarpus
intro: Dipterocarpus retusus var. macrocarpus, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Dipterocarpaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The Borneo ironwood has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties, including its antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
